sharedRules.name: Scouts 8"
sharedRules.description:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. 
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**. 
- If that unit is embarked within a dedicated transport that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that dedicated transport has the Scouts ability, that dedicated transport can make a **scout move**.

sharedRules.name: Infiltrators
sharedRules.description: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

sharedRules.name: Deadly Demise
sharedRules.description:
This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6"). 
***Example:** An Impulsor with a unit of Intercessors embarked within it is **destroyed** by ranged attacks. First, any unresolved attacks made by the attacking unit are resolved. Then the Intercessors make an **emergency disembark move**. Then the roll is made for the **Deadly Demise** ability, and on a 6, that ability is resolved. Finally, the Impulsor is removed from the battlefield.*

sharedRules.name: Leader
sharedRules.description: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

sharedRules.name: Support
sharedRules.description:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each **leader** and **support** unit in your army, you can select one friendly **bodyguard** unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that **bodyguard** unit for the battle and form an **attached** unit with it. 
Unless otherwise stated, each **bodyguard** unit can only have one **leader** unit and one **support** unit attached to it.

sharedRules.name: Melta X
sharedRules.description: When damage is dealt with a Melta weapon, if the attacking model is within half range of the target, add X to the damage.

sharedRules.name: Deep Strike
sharedRules.description: When this unit makes an ingress move, if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere outside of 8" horizontally from enemy units.

sharedRules.name: Critical: X
sharedRules.description: On an unmodified hit roll of 6, a weapon triggers the additional effect "X".

sharedRules.name: Torrent
sharedRules.description: Do not make a hit roll for weapons with this keyword, they automatically hit.

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description: If a unit moved less than 3" this turn, it has +1 to hit with this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Assault
sharedRules.description: When selected to shoot, this unit can follow the Assault Shooting rules.

sharedRules.name: Melee
sharedRules.description: Weapons with this keyword do not suffer the penalty for being within 2" of an enemy Infantry/Beast/Swarm unit.

sharedRules.name: Hazardous
sharedRules.description: Each time an attack is made with a Hazardous weapon, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound before any re-rolls are made.

sharedRules.name: Precision
sharedRules.description: When an attack with a Precision weapon is made against a character unit, saves against that attack can be allocated to a character model in that unit instead of the bodyguard.

sharedRules.name: Ignores Cover
sharedRules.description: The penalty for shooting a unit in cover does not apply to this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Feel No Pain X+
sharedRules.description: When a unit with this ability takes damage, roll a D6 for each point of damage. A successful roll of X+ reduces the incoming damage by 1.

sharedRules.name: Warlord
sharedRules.description: When the unit containing the Warlord model is targeted with a stratagem, reduce the cost of that stratagem by 1CP.

sharedRules.name: Anti-X: Y+
sharedRules.description: When an weapon with this keyword rolls to wound, if the target unit has X keyword, attacks automatically wound on unmodified rolls of Y+ or better.

sharedRules.name: One Shot
sharedRules.description: This weapon can only be fired once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Lance
sharedRules.description: If the model on which this weapon is equipped made a charge move this turn, this weapon has +1 to wound.

sharedRules.name: Lone Operative X"
sharedRules.description: This unit is not visible to any model outside of X".

sharedRules.name: Extra Attacks
sharedRules.description: When a model equipped with an extra attacks weapon fights, they can make attacks with that weapon in addition to one other non-extra attacks melee weapon.
